# epair

A package designed to aid in getting data from the Environmental
Protection Agency (EPA) API at
<https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/documents/data_api.html>.

### Overview

The `epair` package helps you determine what data you want and how to
get that data from the EPA API. It provides loaded in variables that
help you navigate services in the API, and a simple way to query the
data.

Broadly, you can explore possible calls by typing `epair::get_` and
seeing what autocomplete offers in R. Most of these functions require a
start and end date along with a geographical boundary type (like CBSA
code or bounding box). For more details, we recommend looking at the
help docs `?epair::get_[type]()` for the function you’re interested in
using to see the exact required params.

### Installation

You can download the package simply by using `r-universe`.

    install.packages("epair", repos = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev")

Alternativately, you can download the latest release from this repo
using `devtools`.

    devtools::install_github("ropensci/epair")

Or, download these files, and in your working directory run the
following.

    devtools::install("ropensci/epair")

`epair` depends on `httr` for making its data calls and `rvest` for
creating the variables loaded in with the package. We recommend having
`httr` installed (automatically taken care of through package
dependencies), and only installing `rvest` if you’re curious about how
package variables were made.

## Usage notes

Note that currently a single call to AQS allows for at maximum a single
year’s worth of data. You’ll need to create separate calls to get
multiple year’s worth of data.

### ropenaq

You may want to check out `ropenaq` instead depending on the goals
behind your study. `ropenaq` is an R wrapper for accessing the OpenAQ
API - see its website [here](https://docs.ropensci.org/ropenaq/). Here
are a few differences:

- `epair` will get data from a single source (EPA AQS API), while
  `ropenaq` will be more useful if you’re trying to compare data from
  different sources.

- If you’re interested in data for the US only, `epair` would be an
  appropriate choice. For more locations across the world, `ropenaq`
  would work better.

- `epair’s` data source does offer more granularity than OpenAQ for US
  data. The EPA AQS API can give over 500 parameters/pollutants of
  interest (as opposed to OpenAQ’s 5), county level coverage, and
  unaggregated raw data. By default, OpenAQ will give aggregated data so
  if you’re only interested in aggregations, then OpenAQ is the way to
  go.

### Terms of Service

Make sure you also see the Usage Tips and Terms of Service associated
with using this API at
<https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/documents/data_api.html>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add.variables()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/add.variables.md)
  : Add variables to a query
- [`clear.all.cached()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/clear.all.cached.md)
  : Removes all cached memory of perform.call
- [`clear.cached()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/clear.cached.md)
  : Removes memory of cached perform.call data for specific parameters
- [`create.authentication()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/create.authentication.md)
  : Generate the string authentication needed for EPA API
- [`create.base.call()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/create.base.call.md)
  : Make the first call when forming a query.
- [`endpoints`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/endpoints.md)
  : Endpoints available in the EPA API
- [`get.transpose()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get.transpose.md)
  : Transpose a data frame
- [`get_all_mas()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_all_mas.md)
  : Get Monitoring Agencies.
- [`get_all_pqaos()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_all_pqaos.md)
  : Get Primary Quality Assurance Organizations.
- [`get_annual_summary_in_bbox()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_annual_summary_in_bbox.md)
  : Get annual summary data in a bounding box (lat, long).
- [`get_annual_summary_in_cbsa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_annual_summary_in_cbsa.md)
  : Get annual summary data in a Core Based Statistical Area.
- [`get_annual_summary_in_county()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_annual_summary_in_county.md)
  : Get annual summary data in a county.
- [`get_annual_summary_in_site()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_annual_summary_in_site.md)
  : Get annual summary data at a measurement site.
- [`get_annual_summary_in_state()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_annual_summary_in_state.md)
  : Get annual summary data in a state.
- [`get_aqs_key()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_aqs_key.md)
  : Get an API key from the AQS API.
- [`get_cbsas()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_cbsas.md)
  : Get all Core Based Statistical Areas.
- [`get_counties_in_state()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_counties_in_state.md)
  : Get all counties within a state.
- [`get_daily_summary_in_bbox()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_daily_summary_in_bbox.md)
  : Returns daily summary data given a bounding box (lat, long).
- [`get_daily_summary_in_cbsa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_daily_summary_in_cbsa.md)
  : Get daily summary data in a Core Based Statistical Area.
- [`get_daily_summary_in_county()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_daily_summary_in_county.md)
  : Returns data summarized by day at the county level.
- [`get_daily_summary_in_site()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_daily_summary_in_site.md)
  : Returns data summarized by day at measurement site level.
- [`get_daily_summary_in_state()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_daily_summary_in_state.md)
  : Returns daily data at the state level.
- [`get_fields_by_service()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/epair/reference/get_fields_by_service.md)
  : Get fields required per service.
